blocks.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللهِ لَا نُرِيْدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَاءً وَّلَا شُكُوْرًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And out of love for Him they feed the poor, the orphan and the captive. (They say:) “We feed you only for the Countenance of Allah! We seek from you neither any recompense nor thanks (for it).”

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Aas (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ اَطْعَمَ اَخَاهُ خُبْزًا حَتَّي يُشْبِعَهُ، وَسَقَاهُ مَاءً حَتَّي يُرْوِيَهُ، بَعَّدَهُ اللهُ عَنِ النَّارِ سَبْعَ خَنَادِقَ، بُعْدُ مَا بَيْنَ خَنْدَقَيْنِ مَسِيْرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ سَنَةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٤ /١٢٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Aas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever feeds his (Muslim) brother until his stomach is full and gives him water to drink, Allah Ta'ala will place a distance of seven trenches between him and the Fire; the gap between two trenches is a distance of five hundred years.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِنَّ مِنْ مُوْجِبَاتِ الْمَغْفِرَةِ اِطْعَامُ الْمُسْلِمِ السَّغْبَانِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Feeding a Muslim who is suffering from hunger is among the things that make forgiveness obligatory.”
